description: A painted interior in an oil-painting style. A man in a dark frock coat and bow tie leans over a black ornate typewriter with floral gold decoration, set on a wooden table with a cast-iron treadle-style base. A younger man in a waistcoat and rolled sleeves watches closely beside him. Behind them are a lit oil lamp, shelves of tools, rifles mounted on a wall, a window, and a horse-drawn carriage visible outside. No visible text, no frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
